type: three gamevisualdirection proposals with world/dialogue framepairs

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE wide landscape 16:9 image simulating a FULL SCREEN DURING PLAY in an original non-photorealistic living-world narrative RPG inspired by Văn Lang–Âu Lạc. This is a concept for game appearance, not an implemented game screenshot or a real3D scene. Build an original visual language from large designed SHAPES, readable silhouettes, character proportions and camera. No presentation board, no asset catalogue, no character turnaround strip, no triptych, no split panels, no large title. Fill the whole image with ONE coherent playable scene and its small game UI.
Shared situation: a river landing with a boat being worked on, a clear path rising to a raised communal house, a timber working platform and a third adult carrying goods nearby. A visible protagonist is a middle-aged sturdy Southeast Asian woman, short strong silhouette, clay-red simple draped upper garment, deep indigo wrapped lower garment, offwhite headband, short dark hair with one grey streak and one small shoulder satchel. An older thin male boatworker has a large angular nose, short white-grey hair, an undyed cream simple garment and dark blue wrap. The woman is an example of a received random life, not a fixed hero or character creator. No origin-selection screen. Clothes and buildings are imaginative art-direction proposals, NOT verified archaeological reconstruction. Convey a skilled, living community, not a primitive camp or a museum display.
Cultural shape sources translated inventively: a raised house with a very clear long curved roof, visible floor and posts with large empty gaps underneath; a long hollow canoe-shaped boat with an emphatic bow; human work read through weight and support of hands/body; rhythm of posts and working groups rather than drum motifs pasted everywhere. No European castles, imperial Chinese tiled roofs, pagodas, ornate gildedfantasy panels, modern objects or weapons/armor as default identity. No need for feather headdresses, magical particles or green bronze skin.
UI uses a restrained small ivory-and-dark-indigo graphic system with generous quiet space and a single clay-red selected mark, simple easily understood useful-object icons. Only short Vietnamese interface labels, no invented stats, lore, quest deadlines, minimap secrets or complex icon clouds. UI text is illustrative. No watermarks.
VISUAL FORM — EXTREME STYLIZED REALTIME-VIDEOGAME 3D APPEARANCE: The people are visibly designed LOW-POLYGON volumetric shapes, roughly FOUR heads tall, short substantial legs, broad wedge feet, oversized simple slab hands, large designed noses/ears, expressive simple eyes. Adult age comes from brow, jaw, posture and hair shapes, NOT realistic skin anatomy or tiny wrinkles. Every face is a handful of matte flat-color planes, no pores. Bodies have clear side/front planes and chunky clothing volumes. This is not a natural-proportioned human with a cartoon shader. Environment obeys exactly the same abstraction: roof is two or three broad curved masses, bundles/posts are clean solid shapes, tree canopies are a few large asymmetrical volumes, boats a few broad faces with legible hollow interiors, ground broad quiet color areas. Deliberately few well-shaped props. Softly faceted silhouettes, plain colors, TWO OR THREE broad shadow values, crisp contact shadows, one coherent diffuse daylight. Large shape rhythm is more important than surface detail. Real videogame look rather than a photo of a miniature: no display plinth, no tilt-shift, NO depth-of-field, no grain/paper/brush texture, NO photorealism, no handpainted realistic background, no fabric weave, no grass blades, no individual thatch strands or scattered microdetail. Saturation controlled in local colors: lively leafy green masses, pale blue-grey water, warm clay ground, deep indigo, clayred and cream clothing. Do not grade the entire frame brown. Everything important is in focus. Exaggeration can remain mature and emotionally credible.
CAMERA: elevated three-quarter orthographic-like game camera at roughly 35–40degree downward angle. Frame one compact but continuous bank/yard area, not an entire village on a base. Woman roughly8–10% of full imageheight at this worldcamera, short chunky silhouette clearly distinct from taller thin worker and wide porter. Show roof front/side/top planes and empty space below raisedfloor. Paths continue beyond frame.
FRAME: world exploration. The woman is approaching the older boatworker who rests one hand on a timber brace beside the boat, while the porter follows the open path. Make feet, route and approach direction unmistakable. No giant hero posed in foreground. Small unobtrusive UI: upper-left a tiny circular silhouette marker for protagonist, upper-right two compact tabs “Nhật ký” and “Túi đồ”, near the worker one small interaction prompt “Hỏi chuyện” with a simple talk glyph. No dialogue window yet. No minimap, no HP bars, no numbered tutorial annotations or glowing navigation trail. Useful satchel/paddle icons use exactly the same shape vocabulary as the world. Keep more than 90% of the image available to the scene.
